description: A monthly bid for a commercial cleaning contract (office, medical office, school, retail, gym, church, warehouse) from the cleanable square feet and how often it is cleaned. Returns the monthly price, price per visit, price per square foot, labor hours and profit. Production rates are starting assumptions to replace with timed numbers.

facility.description: Kind of building: office (Office), medical (Medical or dental office), school (School or daycare), retail (Retail store), gym (Gym or fitness studio), church (Church or event space), warehouse (Warehouse or light industrial). Default office.

hourlyWage.description: Cleaner pay per hour, in dollars. Default 18.

marginPct.description: Target profit margin, percent of the price. Default 20.

name: bid_commercial_cleaning
title: Commercial cleaning bid calculator
